functionalRequirement: The system shall be able to grant edit permissions for assets to departmental administrators, inventory users, faculty users, and university users based on their department affiliation and authorization level.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authentication: The system must implement multi-factor authentication for all user roles with edit permissions, requiring at least two of: password, biometric, or hardware token.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures secure access control for sensitive asset editing capabilities across different user types.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Access Control: The system must implement role-based access control (RBAC) with granular permission levels that can be precisely configured for each user type and department affiliation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Supports the requirement to differentiate edit permissions based on user roles and departmental associations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must maintain a comprehensive audit log of all permission changes, including user ID, timestamp, and specific permission modifications.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides accountability and traceability for permission-related actions across different user types.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The permission management system must allow dynamic updates to user roles and permissions without requiring application downtime.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enables flexible management of user access rights as organizational structures change.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support 100% of defined user roles (departmental administrators, inventory users, faculty users, university users) with distinct permission granularity.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures comprehensive coverage of all specified user types in the permission granting process.

functionalRequirement: Texts sent to that number will be sent to the API, then the system will reply to the user with the answer as another text message.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must process and respond to text message API requests within 2 seconds for 99% of incoming messages.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures rapid message processing and response for real-time communication.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The text messaging API must maintain 99.9% uptime with automatic failover mechanisms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Guarantees consistent message transmission and reception capabilities.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: All text messages must be encrypted in transit using TLS 1.3 with end-to-end encryption.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive communication between the user and the system.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Interoperability: The system must support multiple SMS gateway protocols and be able to integrate with at least three major telecommunications providers.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures flexibility in message routing and delivery across different communication platforms.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: Implement automatic message validation to prevent processing of malformed or excessively long text messages, with clear error feedback to the user.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides a robust user experience by handling potential input errors gracefully.
